reason: While the passage unequivocally demonstrates that proper worship/service (עבודה - 'avadat/service to God) is critically important to Yahweh, explicitly shown through the repeated command 'שַׁלַּח עַמִּי וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי' ('Let my people go that they may serve/worship me'), the text does not explicitly mention sacrifice (זבח zabach or קרבן korban). The passage focuses on the plagues as divine demonstrations of Yahweh's power and the justification for releasing Israel so they may worship Him, but sacrifice is not referenced in this specific fragment. The statement requires both elements; only worship is clearly attested in this text.
